clue.text: Only some diehard Tories will make an attractive proposition?

parts.note: only some of something is merely a portion of it, a small amount
Tories who are wholly right-wing are entirely of the right, every bit right

explanation.surface: Just a few hardline Conservatives will produce an appealing idea.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads cryptically as 'a portion of the entire Right'. The phrase is British slang for a sexually attractive person.
explanation.definitionFit: British slang calls a desirable, good-looking person this, someone who is an appealing prospect.

clue.text: Living material little active, taking in oxygen

indicators.note: taking in means the pair of words around it swallows the next piece

parts.note: a little is a bit
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen
A is the grammar abbreviation for active

explanation.surface: Organic matter is small and lively, absorbing a gas.
explanation.definitionFit: Biota is the collective flora and fauna of a region, its living things.

clue.text: Fetish's time wrapped in fur? Not initially

indicators.note: wrapped in means the time word is enclosed by the fur word
not initially means the first letter of the fur word is dropped

parts.note: a stole is a fur wrap worn on the shoulders
tempo is musical time or pace

explanation.surface: A fetishist's moment spent cocooned in fur, but somehow not at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Not initially' leaves TOLE, which 'wrapped in' puts round the time word. 'Fetish's' reads as a possessive but is just the definition with a link 's.
explanation.definitionFit: A carved pole bearing totems is a revered object, a kind of fetish or emblem venerated by a people.

clue.text: Collection of trees starts to flare on getting alight

indicators.note: starts to means take the opening letter of each of the next words

parts.note: to alight is to come down and settle, to rest

explanation.surface: Woodland catches fire as the first flames take hold.
explanation.definitionFit: A forest is a large area covered thickly with trees, a wood.

clue.text: See 1
Unexpected noise scandals in remote territory

indicators.note: unexpected suggests these letters turn up in a surprising new arrangement

explanation.surface: Surprising, loud scandals break out in a far-flung colony.
explanation.definitionFit: This British overseas territory is an isolated island in the middle of the South Atlantic.

clue.text: Mostly unable to shift painting, upset about new artworks

indicators.note: about means the turned letters go around the new piece
upset in a down clue means the combined letters are turned upside down, read backwards
mostly means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: something unable to shift is stuck fast
an oil is a painting done in oils

explanation.surface: An immovable picture, mostly, is knocked over near some new works.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mostly' leaves STUC; 'upset' turns that and the painting backwards to LIOCUTS, and 'about' wraps it round N. 'Shift' suggests movement but simply means budge.
explanation.definitionFit: Prints made from designs cut into linoleum blocks are works of art.

clue.text: Topic is certain to ignore rule

indicators.note: to ignore means the rule letter is left out of the word for certain

parts.note: certain means sure

explanation.surface: A subject that is sure to disregard regulations.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue is a matter under discussion, a subject or question.

clue.text: Pioneer residence having money invested in garden and stable, mostly

indicators.note: invested in fits the money theme: one piece is put inside another

parts.note: to hoe is to garden, working the soil

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: stable means steady

explanation.surface: A settler's house where cash has been sunk into the garden and the stables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Garden' is a verb here, HOE; 'stable' is the adjective STEADY, not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: Settlers on the American frontier were granted land and built a farmhouse with outbuildings on it.

clue.text: Some Hispanic fellow-actor's expression of ability

parts.note: a fellow actor sharing top billing is a co-star
saying you are able is saying 'I can'

explanation.surface: A Latin American actor's colleague declares himself capable.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of a Central American Spanish-speaking republic is one kind of Hispanic person.

clue.text: Problem with phosphorus in drain

parts.note: a sum is an arithmetic problem
P is the chemical symbol for phosphorus

explanation.surface: Trouble with a chemical element clogging the drains.
explanation.definitionFit: A sump is a pit or well into which waste liquid drains.

clue.text: Grated topping making her canapés seem odd

indicators.note: odd suggests the letters are in a strange order and need rearranging

parts.note: the word is used for its letters, the accent dropped

explanation.surface: A cheese sprinkled on her party snacks makes them look strange.
explanation.definitionFit: This hard Italian cheese is commonly shredded and sprinkled over pasta and other dishes.

clue.text: See 11
Excessive love for German?

parts.note: OTT, over the top, means excessive
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Too much affection for a German person.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a common German first name, so a German man might be called it.

clue.text: Somehow make do with hit operetta

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters are put together in some other way

explanation.surface: An improvised hit musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Gilbert and Sullivan's comic opera set in Japan is a famous light opera.

clue.text: Number returned after review of train company information system

indicators.note: after means the turned number comes after the reworked letters
a review revises something, so the letters are reworked
returned means the number word is read backwards

parts.note: ten is a number

explanation.surface: A rail firm's computer network is checked after a reversal of figures.
explanation.definitionFit: An internal private network used within an organisation shares its information among staff.

clue.text: Repast with pie may be elaborated — with this?

definitions.text: Repast with pie may be elaborated — with this?

indicators.note: elaborated means worked up into something new, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A meal with a pie might be expanded by adding a starter.
explanation.definitionFit: A starter served before a main meal stimulates the appetite, extending the repast.

clue.text: English journalists indulging in very much coffee

indicators.note: indulging in means the journalists sit inside the word for very much

parts.note: so means very much, as in 'so kind'
the press is journalists collectively

explanation.surface: English reporters treat themselves to plenty of coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong black coffee forced through ground beans under steam pressure is an espresso.

clue.text: Canadian pianist, fellow taking in SF film

indicators.note: taking in means the fellow word encloses the film

parts.note: a fellow is a person
ET is Spielberg's science-fiction film about an alien

explanation.surface: A Canadian musician and a friend go to see a sci-fi movie.
explanation.definitionFit: Oscar Peterson was a celebrated jazz pianist from Montreal.

clue.text: Schools a Parisian to get out of sterling

indicators.note: to get out of means the French article is removed from the money word

parts.note: sterling is counted in pounds
a Parisian would say un for 'a'

explanation.surface: Educational institutions for a French person who wants to leave the pound.
explanation.definitionFit: Groups of whales or dolphins are called pods, as fish swim in schools.

clue.text: Apartments containing zero amounts of cash

indicators.note: containing means the apartments word holds the zero

parts.note: flats are apartments
zero looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Flats that have no money in them.
explanation.definitionFit: A float is a sum of cash kept in a till to give change.

clue.text: Darkest time of year knocked scientist lower

indicators.note: knocked suggests the letters are battered into a new shape

explanation.surface: A researcher was demoted in the gloomiest season.
explanation.definitionFit: The shortest day, in December in the northern hemisphere, has the least daylight of the year.

clue.text: Quantity of energy displayed by branch of armed forces?

definitions.meaning: a unit of heat used for measuring gas supply in Britain
read as two words, it is the Royal Marines, RM, with the article in front

explanation.surface: A measure of power shown off by a military unit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'displayed by' just links the two senses; the question mark flags that the second reads the answer split as THE RM, RM being the Royal Marines.
explanation.definitionFit: A unit of heat equal to 100,000 British thermal units is a measure of energy.

clue.text: See 21
Scale in C undercut by tearaway

indicators.note: undercut by in a down clue means the second piece goes beneath the first

parts.note: a limb, short for limb of Satan, is a mischievous child or tearaway

explanation.surface: A musical scale in C major is undermined by a wild youngster.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scale' looks musical, especially beside C, but it is the verb, to climb.
explanation.definitionFit: To scale a wall or peak is to ascend it.

clue.text: Man almost entirely taken in by the writer

indicators.note: taken in by means the shortened word sits inside the writer word

parts.note: the writer of a clue refers to themselves as me

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: entirely means all

explanation.surface: A fellow was almost completely fooled by the author.
explanation.definitionFit: A man is a male person.

clue.text: This may become an emphasis when adrift

definitions.text: This may become an emphasis when adrift

indicators.note: adrift means loose and wandering, so the letters drift into a new order

explanation.surface: Being lost at sea makes skilled sailing a priority.
explanation.walkthrough: Rearranged, the answer's letters become 'an emphasis'; and the skill is what counts when a boat is drifting.
explanation.definitionFit: The skill of handling a vessel at sea matters most when it is drifting.

clue.text: Wretch to abandon entering forest prison

parts.note: a worm is a contemptible wretch

indicators.note: entering means the abandon word goes inside the forest word

parts.note: woods are a forest
to scrub a plan is to cancel or abandon it

explanation.surface: A villain who gives up hiding in the woods ends up in jail.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a well-known prison in west London.
explanation.definitionFit: This Victorian jail in Hammersmith is one of the best-known British prisons.
